text:
#!name=DLabel云标签
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0115 / DLabel云标签 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0022 / Dlabel云标签去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/imagepc\.ctaiot\.com\/dlabel\/0\/startpage/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/dudian-oss\.oss-cn-shenzhen\.aliyuncs\.com\/dlabel\/1\/startpage/i then reject(404)

[Map Local]
^https:\/\/dlabel\.ctaiot\.com\/api\/spreadstart\/list\.json\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/dlabel\.ctaiot\.com\/api\/spread\/journey\/select\.json\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% dudian-oss.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com, imagepc.ctaiot.com, dlabel.ctaiot.com
